║                                                            ║
║      Barnard's Star wanted a Legacy Core Fragment          ║
║      and got a sun instead.                                ║
║      Stonecrest reached for the Veiled Crown Nebula        ║
║      and closed its fist on bare light.                    ║
║      Ankaa asked for The Black Ridge                       ║
║      and was handed only Ankaa Star, still burning.        ║
║                                                            ║
║      This is how empire invoices wonder:                  ║
║      wrong destination, correct charge.                    ║
║                                                            ║
║      In Ivorygate, Forgotten Prism kept its name           ║
║      while Fortress 'Fight' Fisher and                     ║
║      Scott 'Scrapper' Jr. orbited like bad advice.         ║
║      In Wezen Faint Entanglement, the nebula               ║
║      tangled less than the routes to reach it.             ║
║      Tabit I sat beneath Tabit Cryobelt                    ║
║      and Tabit Cobalt Shelf like a worker                  ║
║      between freezer and mine.                             ║
║                                                            ║
║      Garnet Dim Lattice shimmered like a luxury cage.      ║
║      GSC-0041 Star watched Combat Drone 259                ║
║      patrol a frost ring no one could afford to eat.       ║
║      Hassaleh Ice Halo was a wedding ring                  ║
║      slipped onto the hand of vacancy.                     ║
║      Sulafat Belt turned slowly while Lumina               ║
║      glowed like a slogan for hope.                        ║
║      Menkib Stellar Wind sold motion without mercy.        ║
║      Dubhe III, GSC-0014 I, Summervale Belt—               ║
║      all of them circling the same old register.           ║
║                                                            ║
║      Two suns in Alzirr.                                   ║
║      One mouth called The Maw.                             ║
║      The other sold authentication papers.                 ║
║                                                            ║
║      Somewhere at Argon Bank Range,                         ║
║      antimatter trace and drifting alloy                   ║
║      wait to be renamed as opportunity.                    ║
║      Somewhere in Summervale Belt,                         ║
║      a gas pocket rehearses a speech about abundance       ║
║      while the rocks keep quiet.                           ║
║                                                            ║
║      The stations say value.                               ║
║      The belts say hunger.                                 ║
║      The nebulae say nothing at all,                       ║
║      which is why they sound honest.                       ║
